1.e4 c5 2.d4 cxd4 3.Qxd4 Nc6 4.Qd1 Nf6 5.strategy: Offers the e4 pawn, which the knight on f6 already attacks, for a bishop aimed at f7. A gambit with little behind it: Black can simply take the pawn, and White has to make the pressure on f7 count at once.
1.e4 c5 2.d4 cxd4 3.Qxd4 Nc6 4.Qd1 Nf6 5.name: Sicilian Defence: Coles Sicilian Gambit
